cases.disposition_reason: showcase --page dialogs opens the Dialogs page in src/bin/showcase/pages/dialogs.rs. The Rename task… button opens Dialog::prompt titled Rename task, whose body is the Task name field. Esc dismisses that dialog through Dialog::on_key in src/widgets/dialog.rs, and DialogsPage::result_line records Cancelled. The page keeps Migrate sessions table. finish then sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0.
cases.entry_path: showcase --page dialogs --color truecolor --motion reduced, then the Rename task… button
cases.return_path: Esc cancels the Rename task dialog back to Dialogs, then finish sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: KeyRouter::paste in src/shell/router.rs gives the paste to layer_paste, and page_paste runs only when no layer claims it. Showcase::layer_paste in src/bin/showcase/app.rs delivers the paste to the top layer. Dialog::on_paste in src/widgets/dialog.rs inserts into the prompt field. The Rename task dialog is that field, opened from src/bin/showcase/pages/dialogs.rs. A bracketed paste of qx01paste replaces the selected name in the field. The page label Task: Migrate sessions table does not gain it, Nothing yet stays, and Renamed to does not appear while the dialog is open. A single-line Editor::paste in src/widgets/edit.rs joins a newline with a space, so alpha and beta paint as alpha beta. A λ paste stays in the field. Pasted q and Ctrl+Q paint as qCtrl+Q, the process keeps running, and that text does not quit or leave the dialog. On macOS, FieldKeys::Emacs in src/core/edit.rs binds ctrl+w to Cut. App::key ctrl+w clears the selected name and does not insert w. The page label keeps Migrate sessions table. KeyboardProtocol in src/core/keyboard.rs reads JUNIE_TUI_KEYBOARD_PROTOCOL. With off, and with the default, a typed z still replaces the selected name. The 120×40 and 80×24 frames are one session after that token paste, then a resize, with no nudge. Both show Rename task and qx01paste, and neither shows Renamed to.
cases.action_sequence: Send a modified key, a bracketed paste, multiline paste, control-like text, and Unicode. Paste while a modal is open.
cases.expected_results: The modal receives the paste. The page underneath does not.
cases.forbidden_effects: Control-like paste text is executed as a shortcut.
